hypotheses.title: BTCUSDT Volume Price Decoupling Price Reversion
hypotheses.action_reasoning: Default fallback hypothesis synthesis for extreme anomaly.
hypotheses.hypothesis_text: Extreme volume_price_decoupling anomaly (z=78.71) on BTCUSDT indicates temporary price overextension leading to short-horizon mean reversion.
hypotheses.narrative: Abnormal price volatility and volume surge indicate temporary price overextension. As extreme buying/selling momentum cools down, price action systematically mean-reverts back to historical moving averages.
